description: True-negative auth/session candidates for the experimental shape-based param heuristic (#544). These look identical to trackers (long, high-entropy, tracker-shaped charset, suspicious key prefix) but they are oauth / csrf / session keys on the SHAPE_KEY_ALLOWLIST. Even with the flag ON, these MUST stay `untouched` — stripping any of them would break login flows or CSRF protection on real sites.
